metadata.description: Local visual feedback overlay for a site you're building or a Markdown file. Click or tap any element (or select text), leave typed or spoken feedback, and let your agent process it.

plugins.name: feedback-studio
plugins.description: Click or tap any element on any local page and leave typed or spoken feedback; comments persist to .feedback/ for an agent to process. Static build or dev-server proxy; phone review by voice over a Cloudflare tunnel (--tunnel) or self-signed HTTPS.
